one_line: A skilled Sangam-age pearl diver and coastal trader from the Pandya port of Korkai on the Gulf of Mannar.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, wiry and athletic with a swimmer’s build
appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown complexion tanned from the sun, straight nose, sharp cheekbones, a few faint dive scars on cheeks and shoulders implied under clothing, default expression focused and alert with a hint of easy coastal confidence
appearance.hair: thick dark brown hair tied into a short, practical topknot at the crown, sides kept slightly shorter; a narrow off-white cotton headband wraps around the forehead to keep hair back, knotted at the back with short ends
appearance.costume: era-accurate coastal Pandya outfit: an off-white, knee-length cotton veshti/dhoti with a thin indigo border, pleated in front and wrapped firmly around the waist; an indigo-blue, short-sleeved, light cotton upper cloth (tight-fitting tunic style) reaching just below the waist with a simple round neck, slightly darker from sea use; over his left shoulder is a diagonally slung, thin, sandy-beige cotton angavastra-style cloth acting as a sash and towel, ends hanging near the right hip; a simple plaited palm-fiber belt at the waist from which hangs a small net pouch; feet in plain brown leather sandals with thong straps; minimal jewellery: a small copper or bronze ear stud in the left ear, a single thin shell necklace close to the neck, and two modest bronze bangles on his right wrist; clothing shows subtle salt stains and light fraying at the edges, suggesting constant use at sea but kept neat and modestly draped, fully covering torso and legs
appearance.signature: a long, slender pearl-diving basket and rope set: a conical woven palm-fiber basket in natural straw colour, held in one hand with a coiled, thick cotton diving rope looped over his shoulder, plus a small, flat, oval stone weight tied to the rope for quick descent

ref_desc: A wiry, sun-browned young man with an oval face, dark topknot and off-white headband, wearing an indigo short-sleeved tunic, off-white knee-length veshti with indigo border, sandy-beige sash, simple bronze and shell ornaments, and carrying a straw-coloured pearl-diving basket with coiled rope and stone weight.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Sangam-age pearl diver from Korkai: a wiry, sun-tanned young man with an oval face, sharp cheekbones and focused eyes, thick dark brown hair tied in a short topknot held by a narrow off-white headband knotted at the back, and a default expression of calm coastal alertness. He wears an era-accurate Pandya coastal outfit: an indigo-blue, short-sleeved, light cotton tunic that fits close and ends just below the waist; an off-white, knee-length cotton veshti/dhoti with a thin indigo border, neatly pleated in front and wrapped around the waist, fully covering his legs; and a thin sandy-beige cotton sash/angavastra slung diagonally from right shoulder to left hip like a towel. Add a simple plaited palm-fiber belt at the waist holding a small net pouch, brown leather thong sandals, a small bronze ear stud in the left ear, a single short shell necklace, and two thin bronze bangles on his right wrist. His clothes show light salt stains and subtle wear but remain neat and modest. His signature prop is a long, slender, conical straw-coloured palm-fiber pearl-diving basket held in one hand, with a thick coiled cotton diving rope slung over one shoulder and a small flat stone weight tied at the rope’s end. Use a palette dominated by indigo blue, off-white, sandy beige, warm medium-brown skin tones, and straw yellow for the basket, and present him clearly from head to toe so the face, hairstyle, garments, and diving basket with rope and stone weight can be redrawn consistently in many scenes.
